title: metricsd refuses to start: its spool dir isn't actually on the bounded buffer
description_md:
The `metricsd` collector won't start. `metricsdctl start` refuses immediately, saying its configured spool directory isn't on a size-bounded filesystem and it won't risk growing unbounded on the root filesystem. Ops provisioned a dedicated, size-limited buffer mount specifically so this could never happen -- but somewhere between that provisioning and the app's own config, a path stopped matching. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out which path is the real bounded mount and which one the config still names, reconcile them, and get `metricsd` running.

You're done when `metricsd` is actually running *and* spooling to the real size-bounded mount, not just any writable directory.
